name: assign_and_order
template: <% h = {} %><% h[:z] = 1; h[:a] = 2; h[:z] = 3; h.store(:m, 4) %><%= h.inspect %>,<%= h.keys.inspect %>,<%= h.values.inspect %>

name: default_value
template: <% h = Hash.new(0) %><% %w[a b a].each { |w| h[w] += 1 } %><%= h.inspect %>,<%= h['zz'] %>,<%= h.default %>

name: queries
template: <% h = {a: 1, b: 2} %><%= h.key?(:a) %>,<%= h.has_key?(:z) %>,<%= h.include?(:b) %>,<%= h.member?(:a) %>,<%= h.value?(2) %>,<%= h.has_value?(5) %>,<%= h.key(2).inspect %>,<%= h.length %>,<%= h.size %>,<%= h.empty? %>,<%= {}.empty? %>

name: map_select
template: <% h = {a: 1, b: 2, c: 3} %><%= h.map { |k, v| "#{k}#{v}" }.inspect %>,<%= h.select { |k, v| v > 1 }.inspect %>,<%= h.reject { |k, v| v > 1 }.inspect %>,<%= h.filter_map { |k, v| k if v.odd? }.inspect %>,<%= h.find { |k, v| v == 2 }.inspect %>,<%= h.count { |k, v| v > 1 } %>,<%= h.any? { |k, v| v > 2 } %>,<%= h.all? { |k, v| v > 0 } %>

name: sorting
template: <% h = {b: 2, a: 3, c: 1} %><%= h.sort_by { |k, v| v }.inspect %>,<%= h.min_by { |k, v| v }.inspect %>,<%= h.max_by { |k, v| v }.inspect %>,<%= h.sort.inspect %>,<%= h.sort_by { |k, v| -v }.to_h.inspect %>,<%= h.sum { |k, v| v } %>

name: transform
template: <% h = {a: 1, b: 2} %><%= h.transform_values { |v| v * 10 }.inspect %>,<%= h.transform_keys(&:to_s).inspect %>,<%= h.invert.inspect %>,<%= h.to_a.inspect %>,<%= h.to_h { |k, v| [v, k] }.inspect %>

name: merge
template: <% h = {a: 1, b: 2} %><%= h.merge({b: 3, c: 4}).inspect %>,<%= h.merge({b: 3}) { |k, o, n| o + n }.inspect %>,<%= h.inspect %><% h.merge!({d: 5}) %>,<%= h.inspect %><% h.update(e: 6) %>,<%= h.size %>

name: delete_slice_except
template: <% h = {a: 1, b: 2, c: 3, d: nil} %><%= h.delete(:a) %>,<%= h.delete(:zz).inspect %>,<%= h.slice(:b, :c).inspect %>,<%= h.except(:b).inspect %>,<%= h.compact.inspect %>,<%= h.values_at(:b, :q).inspect %>,<%= h.fetch_values(:b, :c).inspect %>

name: delete_if
template: <% h = {a: 1, b: 2} %><% h.delete_if { |k, v| v == 1 } %><%= h.inspect %>

name: group_partition
template: <% h = {a: 1, b: 2, c: 3} %><%= h.group_by { |k, v| v.odd? }.inspect %>,<%= h.partition { |k, v| v > 1 }.inspect %>,<%= h.each_with_index.map { |(k, v), i| "#{k}#{v}#{i}" }.inspect %>

name: reduce_with_object
template: <% h = {a: 1, b: 2} %><%= h.inject(0) { |s, (k, v)| s + v } %>,<%= h.each_with_object({}) { |(k, v), acc| acc[v] = k }.inspect %>
